fields.acceptance: internal/rootcfg and daemon-settings tests show the old key and self_update_project reported with the autoUpdate hint.
fields.statement: rhiza.daemon.selfUpdate and rhiza.toml's self_update_project are removed: a root that still sets either keeps loading, selfUpdate = true is read as rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate = main (unless autoUpdate is set), the daemon logs a message naming rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate, and the next write of rhiza.toml drops the old keys; daemon set of the old key is refused with that message.

set.statement: On this VM ~/code is the root with rhiza and nebari registered, rhiza-root.service runs the root daemon with rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate = main (carried over from the removed self_update_project and rhiza.daemon.selfUpdate = true), rhiza-rhiza.service is uninstalled, and the rhiza project's machine settings moved from its git config into rhiza.toml.
